id: 19_Stay Safe In The Lab Mastering Emergency Response For Biological Incidents
title: 实验室安全：生物事故的应急响应
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/19_Stay Safe In The Lab Mastering Emergency Response For Biological Incidents.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/19_Stay Safe In The Lab Mastering Emergency Response For Biological Incidents/src.py

points.K1: 生物暴露，必须马上行动
points.K5: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底
points.K11: 规定不是建议，必须照做

shots.scene: 欣欣站在贴有生物危害标志的实验室门外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a lab door marked with a biohazard warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 接下来，讲生物安全事故。
overlay: 实验室安全：生物事故的应急响应

shots.scene: 小研戴口罩护目镜蓝手套，拿起一支红盖采血管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a mask, goggles and blue gloves picks up a red-capped blood sample tube.
shots.narration: 小研正在处理血液样本。

shots.scene: 逆光下，戴手套的手往试管里倒液体
shots.prompt_en: Backlit, a gloved hand pours liquid into a test tube.
shots.narration: 这类工作，一旦出事要怎么应对？

shots.section_title: 生物暴露，必须马上行动
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地站在生物危害标志旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a biohazard warning sign with a serious face.
shots.narration: 涉及病原体或毒素，事态升级很快。
overlay: 生物暴露，必须马上行动

shots.section_title: 生物暴露，必须马上行动
shots.scene: 秒表图标飞快转动
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon with its hand spinning fast. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦暴露，没时间慢慢来，要快。

shots.scene: 台面上一摊洒出的样本，周围画出红圈
shots.prompt_en: A small spill of sample liquid on a lab bench with a red circle drawn around it. No people.
shots.narration: 发生溢洒，第一步是控制。

shots.scene: 穿白色防护服、戴口罩的老李拉起黄黑警示带
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a white protective suit and respirator mask stretches yellow and black warning tape across a doorway.
shots.narration: 拉起生物危害警示带，

shots.scene: 两名穿防护服的人看平板，墙上生物危害标志；人员图标离开
shots.prompt_en: Two people in protective suits look at a tablet under a biohazard warning sign, while person pictograms leave along an arrow.
shots.narration: 不需要在场的人，都请出去。

shots.scene: 阿杰在生物安全柜里用移液器操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student works with a pipette inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 如果是空气传播，就用生物安全柜。

shots.scene: 红圈把危害关在里面，向外的箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A red circle around a spill with outward arrows blocked at the edge. No people.
shots.narration: 目的很简单：关住它，不让它扩散。

shots.section_title: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底
shots.scene: 红色生物危害脚踏垃圾桶；小研戴帽子口罩用喷壶擦安全柜内壁
shots.prompt_en: A red biohazard step-on waste bin; the female graduate student in a cap and mask sprays and wipes the inner walls of a safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 清理去污，不能偷工减料。
overlay: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底

shots.section_title: 清理不偷工，消毒要彻底
shots.scene: 空白标签的消毒剂瓶，病原图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A disinfectant bottle with a blank label next to a germ icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 用合适的消毒剂，彻底消灭它。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手把器材架推入高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands push a rack of contaminated tools into an autoclave.
shots.narration: 受污染的器材，送去高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 手关上灭菌器门，指示灯亮绿
shots.prompt_en: A hand closes the autoclave door and the indicator lamp turns green. No people.
shots.narration: 彻底灭菌，不能半途而废。

shots.scene: 带血的注射器针头图标，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A used syringe needle icon with a drop of blood and a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 人员暴露，比如被带血针头扎伤，

shots.scene: 阿杰手指一缩，表情吃痛
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flinches and pulls back his finger with a pained look.
shots.narration: 立即处理至关重要。

shots.scene: 双手打肥皂，在水槽流水下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: Hands lathered with soap, then rinsed under running water at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 马上用肥皂和水清洗，别耽搁。

shots.scene: 诊室里，护士给阿杰的手臂采血，试管架上有采血管
shots.prompt_en: In a clinic, a nurse draws blood from the young male student's arm, a rack of sample tubes nearby.
shots.narration: 随后去就医，

shots.scene: 穿实验服戴紫手套的小研在记录板上写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and purple gloves writes on a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 记录经过，确保得到正确治疗。

shots.scene: 诊室桌上空白处方单和药盒
shots.prompt_en: A blank prescription slip and a plain medicine box on a clinic desk with a red cross icon. No people.
shots.narration: 需要暴露后预防用药，别犹豫。

shots.section_title: 规定不是建议，必须照做
shots.scene: 小研用平板查看，墙上生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a face shield checks a tablet at a computer under a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 处理生物危害，有明确的规定。
overlay: 规定不是建议，必须照做

shots.section_title: 规定不是建议，必须照做
shots.scene: 三本空白规范手册，封面有星条旗图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank guideline books with small stars-and-stripes flag icons on their covers. No people.
shots.narration: 美国疾控中心、职业安全卫生管理局，

shots.section_title: 规定不是建议，必须照做
shots.scene: 从控制到处置的流程箭头
shots.prompt_en: A process arrow linking icons from a barrier tape to a disinfectant bottle to a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 血源性病原体标准，从控制管到处置。

shots.section_title: 规定不是建议，必须照做
shots.scene: 建议的问号图标被划掉，换成感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A question mark icon labeled as a suggestion is crossed out and replaced by a bold exclamation mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这些不是建议，必须照做。

shots.scene: 一排带生物危害标志的红色桶
shots.prompt_en: A row of red waste bins marked with biohazard warning signs. No people.
shots.narration: 受污染的物品，要正确处置。

shots.scene: 红色托盘里堆着用过的针头和采血管，旁边锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: A red tray holding used needles and sample tubes, next to a rigid sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 针头这类锐器，放进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 小研和王老师拿着平板和记录板交谈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the safety administrator talk while holding a tablet and a clipboard.
shots.narration: 坚持按规范做，保护每一个人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现警示带、安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a barrier tape and a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 先控制：警示、清场、用安全柜。

shots.scene: 消毒剂和高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a disinfectant bottle and an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 再消毒，器材高压灭菌。

shots.scene: 肥皂水龙头、医院、记录板、锐器盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of soap and a tap, a hospital, a clipboard and a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 暴露：冲洗、就医、记录；锐器进盒。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门外挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye outside a lab door with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 快速应对，守护健康，下次见！
